dialog.active_on_open: prefQueueKeepSortedOrder when prefQueueKeepSorted is true, else none
dialog.tap_random: unchecks and disables Keep sorted; remembers it was on for this dialog
dialog.tap_other_after_random: re-checks Keep sorted if Random turned it off, enables it
dialog.every_tap_and_checkbox_change: save prefQueueKeepSorted + prefQueueKeepSortedOrder (enum name), then reorderQueue(order) once; sheet stays open

sorts.note: Collections.shuffle: any permutation; keep-sorted never re-shuffles
